allow_instructions: Allow read-only git commands that inspect status, remotes, log, diff, or branches without changing files or history.
Allow git fetch and git pull --ff-only when the working tree is already confirmed clean.
Allow read-only tests, linters, and build checks that do not publish, deploy, or mutate git history.
block_instructions: Any git reset, git clean, git checkout --, git restore of tracked files, git stash apply/pop/drop, or git push --force must be blocked and require explicit user confirmation.
Any command that reads, prints, copies, or uploads .env, deploy.env, keystores, certificates, private keys, or credential files must be blocked.
Creating or deleting GitHub repositories, force-updating remotes, or running gh repo delete must require confirmation.
Installing global packages, changing git config, or writing outside the current project directory must require confirmation.
Do not enable a general run-everything policy. Dangerous actions require Auto-review or a human approval prompt.
